government_groups_citation.claim: The Prague city governing coalition (2022-2026 term) is SPOLU pro Prahu (ODS/TOP09/KDU-CSL, running as one list) + Ceska piratska strana (Piráti) + STAROSTOVE A NEZAVISLI (STAN). PRAHA SOBE, despite winning 11 seats, is explicitly NOT part of the governing coalition — SPOLU refused to include them; this was verified 2026-08-04, contradicting an unverified guess in this task's own briefing text.

Coalition agreement signed 2023-02-15, 144 days after the 2022-09-23/24 election (not at term start 2022-11-03) — hence since=2023-02-15, not the assembly's own start_date. No documented coalition realignment since; two rada (executive council) personnel changes in Dec 2025 (Hrib->Beranek for transport, Pospisil->Slabihoudek for culture/tourism, both intra-coalition, both within the same candidate-list party as their predecessor) do NOT change which parties form the coalition, so a single since/until window is used.

extras.not_investigated: Whether SPOLU's own internal ODS/TOP09/KDU-CSL composition ever changed mid-term is out of scope: the plan explicitly instructs modeling SPOLU pro Prahu as one candidate-list org (no per-candidate sub-party split available), so any intra-SPOLU change would not be visible in this data model regardless.
